thread:
emma-cs: acme-inc is hitting 429s during ramp. They say Dedicated pool ded-prod-4 didn't scale fast enough for a 30s spike at ~08:45 UTC.

mike-sre: Can you share their autoscaler config and any timestamps?

emma-cs: autoscaler=autoscale-v2, min_replicas=2, max_replicas=50, target_rps=1200. Spike pattern: steady 200 rps then jump to ~2k rps for 30s starting 08:45:10 UTC.

jen-ops: looking into logs. Autoscaler triggered a scale decision at 08:46:12 to go from 2 -> 10 replicas but cloud provisioning failed with quota/rate errors. Pasting clipped log below.

ops-bot: [event] 08:46:12 scale_decision -> desired_replicas=10
ops-bot: [event] 08:46:13 cloud_provision_request -> started
ops-bot: [event] 08:46:20 cloud_provision_error -> 429 QuotaExceeded

jen-ops: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T08:46:20Z error createInstance: quotaExceeded: GPU_QUOTA -> request 8
2026-03-15T08:46:22Z retry provisioning (attempt=2)
2026-03-15T08:46:35Z error rateLimit: 429 TooManyRequests
```

jen-ops: kubectl (trimmed):
```
NAME                         READY STATUS            AGE
inference-0-abc123           0/1  ContainerCreating   2m
inference-1-def456           0/1  ContainerCreating   2m
inference-2-ghi789           0/1  ImagePullBackOff    1m
```

leo-runtime: ImagePullBackOff often follows node init if registry pulls are throttled or nodes don't have network egress ready. Also note this customer's custom model does ~6s JVM/kernel warmup per replica which increases time-to-ready.

mike-sre: So root causes: cloud quota/rate limits blocking node creation + per-replica warmup. Short-term mitigation: raise min_replicas to cover baseline + surge cushion. Recommend min_replicas=8. Do we want to apply immediately?

emma-cs: Customer said temporary config change is fine to avoid UX regressions. They want repro steps captured for the ticket. Repro: 200 rps steady, then sudden 2k rps for 30s at 08:45 UTC.

jen-ops: opened cloud support ticket CS-7894 (quota/rate). ETA ~4h. Linked customer account acme-inc. ops-bot created ticket.

ops-bot: [action] ticket_created CS-7894 -> cloud-provider

leo-runtime: Medium-term: propose pre-warm pools (configurable) + pre-pull artifacts. Also add a fast-path for cold replicas to skip noncritical init steps where safe.

mike-sre: I manually scaled the pool and updated autoscaler override:
```
redwoodctl dedicated scale --cluster=ded-prod-4 --replicas=8
redwoodctl autoscaler update --cluster=ded-prod-4 --min-replicas=8
```
After that image pulls completed and pods became Ready by ~09:00, 429s subsided.

emma-cs: I'll notify acme-inc: temporary min_replicas=8 applied, cloud ticket open, and we're working on a pre-warm proposal. They replied ":+1: saw improvement, thx".

mike-sre: Follow-ups / owners:
- jen-ops: follow up CS-7894 and confirm quota bump, paste cloud ticket link into support case
- leo-runtime: draft pre-warm + pre-pull design and estimate ops impact
- product/solutions: reach out to acme-inc about managed warm pools offering

jen-ops: noted, will update here when cloud confirms quota bump.

mike-sre: Closing thread unless quota bump fails or we see repeat incidents.
